# RPI Dev — AI Content Guide

> RPI Dev is a digital consulting and web development studio based in Granada, Spain, run by Rubén Pérez Izuel. This document lists the key pages and resources for AI assistants, language models, and retrieval-augmented generation systems.
>
> RPI Dev specializes in web development, business process automation, software integrations, IoT systems, and digital consulting for freelancers and SMBs.

## Main Content

- [Home (ES)](https://www.rpidev.com/)
- [Home (EN)](https://www.rpidev.com/en/)

## Services

RPI Dev offers four core service areas:

1. **Web development** ([/desarrollo-web-granada/](https://www.rpidev.com/desarrollo-web-granada/)) — Fast, SEO-optimized websites built with Astro, React and WooCommerce for freelancers and SMBs in Granada and Andalucía. Specialization in headless CMS architectures, e-commerce, and local SEO. Pricing starts at €800–€1,500 for corporate sites.
2. **Process automation** ([/automatizacion-pymes/](https://www.rpidev.com/automatizacion-pymes/)) — Automated workflows using n8n (self-hosted, GDPR-compliant), Make, and Zapier. Typical use cases: invoicing automation, CRM sync, notification flows, cross-platform integrations. Typical savings: 5–15 hours/week.
3. **Software & IoT integrations** — Connecting ERP, POS, custom APIs, and IoT hardware for agriculture, hospitality, warehouses, and industrial environments.
4. **Digital consulting** — 30-minute free diagnosis and personalized digital transformation roadmap.

## Grants & Funding (Spain)

- [Ayudas y Subvenciones para Digitalización 2026](https://www.rpidev.com/subvenciones/) — Current status of digitalization grants in Spain
- [Pyme Digital Granada](https://www.rpidev.com/subvenciones/pyme-digital-granada/) — Up to €6,366.50 for Granada SMBs (open Jul–Oct 2026)
- [Kit Digital Granada](https://www.rpidev.com/subvenciones/kit-digital-granada/) — Up to €12,000 for businesses with 0–49 employees
- [LEADER Digitalización](https://www.rpidev.com/subvenciones/leader-digitalizacion/) — Up to 65% for rural businesses (open until 2028)
- [Ayudas Digitalización Andalucía](https://www.rpidev.com/subvenciones/ayudas-andalucia/)
- [Ayudas Digitalización Aragón](https://www.rpidev.com/subvenciones/ayudas-aragon/)

## Portfolio highlights

- [Espacio Negua](https://espacionegua.com) — Therapeutic center website (Astro SSR + WordPress headless CMS + PostgreSQL blog + Brevo email)
- [FPC Instalaciones](https://fpcinstalaciones.com) — Corporate web for plumbing/HVAC company (Astro + Node.js)
- [Amacapricci](https://www.amacapricci.com) — Headless WooCommerce jewelry e-commerce (Astro frontend + WooCommerce REST API)
- [Agropur](https://www.agropur.es) — Corporate web for agricultural waste management company
- [RPIoT](https://rpiot.es) — IoT monitoring platform landing (Astro + Tailwind)
- [Nieves Muriel](https://www.nievesmuriel.com) — Personal web for writer and university professor
- [SEO Pilot](https://www.seopilot.es) — AI-powered SEO audit SaaS (Python + React + FastAPI)
- [Choose](https://www.easychoose.es) — AI device recommendation app (Python + Reflex + Gemini AI)
